snippet.title: OMORI THE DREAMER Trailer
snippet.description:
THE DREAMER is an OMORI mod (fan sequel) set immediately after the good ending. While telling the truth, SUNNY passes out due to his injuries, returning to dreaming, despite his choice to let go. HEADSPACE is now empty of any residents...or so it appears.
Remember to stay alert, and pay attention. Some things aren't yours anymore.

---
WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE PRELUDE, AVAILABLE FOR DOWNLOAD NOW!
- Playtime range from 4-10 hours
- A brand new area called THE NEIGHBORHOOD
- 50 badges
- 52 original tracks. The OST will be posted both as a compilation and as separate videos a couple days after release to avoid spoilers.
- How you play affects what you will see
- DEMO saves can be used!

---
LINKS!

DOWNLOAD MOD: https://mods.one/mod/thedreamer

TWITTER: https://x.com/OMORIthedreamer
